title: Arcane Aeronautics Tweaks
description: A set of balancing changes for the Arcane Aeronautics mod pack
body:
This is a datapack is meant for use in the Arcane Aeronautics
modpack, on Modrinth.

Dependencies:
- Aetherial Islands
- Aetherial Islands: Clusters Edit
- Ars Nouveau
- Galosphere
- Ice and Fire
- Occultism
- Eureka! Create Airships 

Changes:
- Modifies Aetherial Islands spawn layout to have larger clusters, with larger islands
- Disables spawning for Galosphere, Ice and Fire, and Occultism silver ore
- Makes mineshafts spawn 1/8 as frequently
- Changes Eureka Create Airship helm recipes to use brass casing instead of train casing
